In verify_k33.py every integral chain square vanishes; 792 and 407 exact ±1 cancellations respectively leave C_0=C_4=Z and all other chain modules zero. Armstrong applies because both groups have fixed-point generators, proving pi1=0. Hurewicz and Whitehead yield S^4. Verified actual checker path and output; no extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The primary mathematical comparison is object-level. Stones (2014) supplies the exact labeled K_{3,3} forest face counts but no orbit-space topology; Björner supplies matroid shellability, Armstrong orbit fundamental groups, and Hughes–Swartz a distinct torus-action sphere quotient controlled by a matroid. Closest indexed claims concern K_{2,n}, directed multipaths, Morse matchings, induced-vertex forests or involution fixed sets and neither explicitly nor by their stated implications determine the two integral K_{3,3} graphic-matroid quotient homotopy types. Exact equivalent work not indexed remains a risk.
residual_risks: A mathematically equivalent classification could exist in a nonindexed source; searches are evidence, not proof of global uniqueness.

value.rationale: K_{3,3} is the canonical six-vertex nonplanar Kuratowski graph, and its rank-five forest matroid is a natural minimal balanced cubic graphic matroid. Its covering space has 20 four-sphere summands, but each of two distinct large natural symmetry quotient spaces retains exactly one four-sphere up to homotopy. This supplies complete integral homotopy types beyond known labeled forest counts, rational group characters, or fixed-space information; the computation is finite but the object and invariant have independent structural motivation.
